scope: source-level FreeCAD default C++ DXF importer comparison; not a native execution of FreeCAD main
findings: The pinned 1.1.4 CDxfRead source has no SOLID or 3DFACE dispatcher; its native no-shape results were recorded separately.

At current main, CDxfRead::ReadEntity dispatches SOLID to ReadSolid and ImpExpDxfRead::OnReadSolid constructs the face with DXF corner order 1-2-4-3. There is no corresponding 3DFACE dispatch; generic-shape comments are not a reader route.

Source-level concern: ResolveEntityAttributes computes an OCS matrix, but OnReadSolid passes the raw OCS corners through static makePoint to the collector without applying that matrix. Non-default extrusion needs actual native confirmation, including nested block context and thickness.

Source-level concern: the OCS branch compares signed X/Y to 1/64 instead of their absolute values, and does not normalize the selected X vector. Analytic example normal (-1,0,0) gives source X (0,0,1) but the standard arbitrary-axis X is (0,-1,0); normal (0.6,0,0.8) gives source X (0,0.6,0), length 0.6, rather than normalized (0,1,0). Default normal gives correct X (1,0,0).

Repair the shared basis using absolute threshold tests and normalized axes, checking zero/invalid normals and all OCS consumers; apply orientation to SOLID without double-transforming block geometry.

Implement WCS 3DFACE dispatch with triangular/planar quad handling and explicit disposition of nonplanar faces and group-70 edge visibility; test supported shapes and failure reporting, open/insert and nested blocks.
Keep FreeCAD 1.1.4 and current-master results distinct and repeat native Linux/Windows qualification.
limits: No FreeCAD main build or runtime was executed; source-level concerns are not a measured FreeCAD regression or downstream patch.
